He also featured in major contemporary productions, including the acclaimed film “Aníkúlápò,” and earned honours including the City People Movie Lifetime Achievement Award. He is survived by his wives and children, with funeral arrangements to be announced. Tributes have poured in from colleagues including Femi Adebayo, Odunlade Adekola and Saheed Balogun.

ogogo-taiwo-hassan-stage-4-cancer.html.title: Nollywood Rallies Behind Veteran Actor Taiwo ‘Ogogo’ Hassan Amid Cancer Battle
ogogo-taiwo-hassan-stage-4-cancer.html.excerpt: Nollywood figures including Femi Adebayo and Odunlade Adekola have rallied support for veteran actor Taiwo Hassan, known as “Ogogo,” who is battling stage-four cancer.
paras: Nollywood colleagues, including Femi Adebayo and Odunlade Adekola, have rallied behind veteran actor Taiwo Hassan, popularly known as “Ogogo,” as he battles stage-four cancer.

According to reports, the actor’s family has appealed for urgent medical support, with his daughter seeking treatment options as he is currently unable to travel abroad. Fellow actor Jide Kosoko spoke on the challenge of managing the many offers of help the family has received.

oil-prices-rise-us-iran-hormuz-deadlock..title: Oil Prices Rise as US-Iran Deadline Passes With Strait of Hormuz Still Deadlocked
oil-prices-rise-us-iran-hormuz-deadlock..excerpt: Crude climbed and stocks wavered after a temporary US-Iran framework expired without a deal to fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz, keeping global energy markets on edge.
paras: Oil prices extended gains on Tuesday as a deal between the United States and Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remained distant, a day after the deadline for a truce between the two sides expired.

A temporary framework — a memorandum of understanding signed in June with a 60-day window — lapsed on Monday, August 17, with no indication either side would extend it. West Texas Intermediate rose toward $85 a barrel, while Brent settled just below $91, according to market data.

President Trump said he was not interested in extending the expiring agreement, and the two sides remained far apart on issues including control of the strait. Iran has insisted the US must lift its naval blockade before it fully reopens the waterway, through which roughly a fifth of global energy supplies pass. Analysts note oil has stayed below its earlier war-driven peaks, cushioned by alternative Gulf export routes, higher US production and stockpile drawdowns.

operation-clean-sweep-iv-north-west-offe.title: Operation Fansan Yamma Launches Major Offensive to Crush Terrorist Networks in North West
operation-clean-sweep-iv-north-west-offe.excerpt: The military has launched Operation CLEAN SWEEP IV, a coordinated ground and air offensive targeting terrorist networks across Nigeria's North West, with strikes already reported in Katsina and Zamfara.
paras: The Headquarters Theatre Command, Joint Task Force North West, Operation FANSAN YAMMA, has launched Operation CLEAN SWEEP IV, a simultaneous and deliberate offensive designed to intensify pressure on terrorist and armed criminal elements across the region.

The operation brings coordinated ground and air actions to bear on identified threats across the North Western states, aiming to degrade terrorist capabilities, disrupt their movements and logistics, and deny them the opportunity to establish footholds within Nigerian communities.

In Katsina State, troops of Sector 2 conducted a clearance operation on August 12 around suspected terrorist enclaves along the Dutsinma Local Government Area, forcing terrorists to abandon their positions and withdraw into surrounding bushes. In Zamfara State, the Air Component of Operation FANSAN YAMMA executed precision strikes following intelligence on terrorists converging on motorcycles in Anka Local Government Area, neutralising scores of fighters.

A major component of Operation CLEAN SWEEP IV is the deliberate effort to contain and dismantle the Lakurawa terrorist network across the theatre, preventing the group's infiltration and reinforcement while denying it the ability to exploit border areas as corridors for movement and logistics.

osun-adeleke-accuses-police-apc-intimida.title: Osun Election: Adeleke Accuses Police of Aiding APC to Intimidate Voters
osun-adeleke-accuses-police-apc-intimida.excerpt: Governor Adeleke has accused police officers of tear-gassing voters in Modakeke and Obaagun to help the APC disrupt Saturday's Osun governorship election.
paras: Osun State Governor Ademola Adeleke has accused officers of the Nigeria Police Force of aiding suspected APC thugs to intimidate voters and disrupt Saturday's governorship election, alleging that police tear-gassed voters in Modakeke and Obaagun to force them away from polling units.

"As I am voting right now, I have just received a call in Modakeke and Obaagun that the police are aiding them to tear-gas people so that they can run away. And people are resolute. They just want to perform their civic duty," Adeleke told reporters shortly after casting his vote in Ede.

The governor alleged a specific police officer, nicknamed "London" and said to have been deployed from Port Harcourt, was hiding in Ede to disrupt voting there, and called on the Inspector-General of Police to redeploy him. Adeleke also raised concerns over the collation process, insisting results must move from polling units to wards to local governments before reaching the state level, and warned that the APC had allegedly attempted to introduce fake ballot papers. He said voting had remained peaceful in his own area, expressing confidence he would win the election.

osun-adeleke-loses-bisi-akande-polling-u.title: Osun Election: Adeleke Loses at Bisi Akande's Polling Unit
osun-adeleke-loses-bisi-akande-polling-u.excerpt: APC candidate Bola Oyebamiji defeated Governor Adeleke by 60 votes at the polling unit of APC elder statesman Chief Bisi Akande in Saturday's Osun election.
paras: Incumbent Governor Ademola Adeleke lost to APC candidate Bola Oyebamiji at the polling unit of veteran APC elder statesman Chief Bisi Akande in Saturday's Osun State governorship election.

Adeleke, seeking re-election on the Accord Party platform, polled 121 votes at the unit, while Oyebamiji secured 181 votes, giving the APC candidate a 60-vote margin at the symbolically significant polling unit tied to one of the party's most prominent founding figures in the South-West.

The result is among a string of unit-level outcomes emerging across the state as sorting and counting continued into the evening, with both camps posting wins in different local government areas as collation proceeds toward an official declaration.

osun-adeleke-wins-own-polling-unit-ede.h.title: Osun Election: Jubilation in Ede as Adeleke Wins His Own Polling Unit With 421 Votes
osun-adeleke-wins-own-polling-unit-ede.h.excerpt: Governor Adeleke won his home polling unit in Ede North with 421 votes, triggering celebrations among supporters as counting continued across Osun State.
paras: Governor Ademola Adeleke won his own polling unit in Saturday's Osun State governorship election, securing 421 votes at Ward 02, Polling Unit 009, Abogunde Compound, in Ede North Local Government Area.

The result triggered celebrations among the governor's supporters gathered at the polling unit, with jubilant Accord Party members hailing the outcome as sorting and collation of results progressed across the state. Adeleke had earlier expressed confidence in retaining his seat after casting his ballot at the same polling unit that morning.

His main rival, APC candidate Bola Oyebamiji, similarly voiced optimism about his own chances after voting at Ward 09, Polling Unit 011, in Ikire, Irewole Local Government Area, as both camps awaited fuller results from across Osun's 30 local government areas.

osun-adeleke-wins-oyinlola-polling-unit..title: Osun Election: Adeleke Wins at Oyinlola's Polling Unit Despite Ex-Governor's APC Endorsement
osun-adeleke-wins-oyinlola-polling-unit..excerpt: Adeleke's Accord Party defeated the APC by 40 votes at former Governor Olagunsoye Oyinlola's home polling unit, despite Oyinlola's public backing of APC candidate Oyebamiji.
paras: Governor Ademola Adeleke's Accord Party defeated the APC at the polling unit of former Osun State Governor Olagunsoye Oyinlola, in a result notable for coming despite Oyinlola's recent public endorsement of APC candidate Bola Oyebamiji.

The election, conducted at Court Hall I, Okuku, in Odo-Otin Local Government Area, saw Adeleke's Accord Party secure a 40-vote margin over the APC. Of 228 accredited voters, 220 valid votes were cast, with eight ballots rejected. Minor parties recorded only a handful of votes between them, with several fielding no votes at all at the unit.

Oyinlola, who governed Osun State from 2003 to 2010, had thrown his weight behind Oyebamiji's candidacy ahead of the election despite his own political history within opposition ranks, making the local outcome at his home polling unit a notable talking point as results trickle in from across the state.

osun-election-day-voting-results-live.ht.title: Osun Election: Voting Concludes, Counting Underway Across State
osun-election-day-voting-results-live.ht.excerpt: Voting has concluded in Saturday's Osun governorship election, with INEC uploading results to its IReV portal as counting continues across the state's 30 local government areas.
paras: Voting concluded across Osun State on Saturday in a closely watched governorship election, with the Independent National Electoral Commission uploading results to its Result Viewing Portal (IReV) as sorting and counting continued at polling units.

More than 1.9 million registered voters were eligible to cast ballots in a contest widely viewed as a two-horse race between incumbent Governor Ademola Adeleke of the Accord Party and Bola Oyebamiji of the APC, with Najeem Salaam of the ADC also in the field. Fourteen parties fielded candidates after both the PDP and Labour Party failed to present nominees; two other candidates had withdrawn earlier in the week and endorsed Adeleke.

The election was not without incident. Governor Adeleke alleged that the PDP chairman in the state was arrested at his residence in Ilesa shortly after voting, calling it an attempt to intimidate his supporters, while ADC candidate Najeem Salaam was reportedly whisked away by security operatives after violence broke out at his polling unit in Ejigbo. As of the latest count, INEC had uploaded results from more than 60 percent of the state's 3,763 polling units to IReV, with final collation continuing at the state level.

osun-election-dig-mohammed-security-depl.title: Osun Election: IGP Deploys DIG Ishyaku Mohammed to Coordinate Security Operations
osun-election-dig-mohammed-security-depl.excerpt: IGP Olatunji Disu has deployed DIG Ishyaku Mohammed to coordinate police security operations ahead of Saturday's Osun governorship election.
paras: Inspector-General of Police Olatunji Rilwan Disu has deployed Deputy Inspector-General of Police Ishyaku Mohammed to Osun State to coordinate security operations ahead of Saturday's governorship election, the Nigeria Police Force announced.

Force Public Relations Officer CSP Ani Iniedu said the deployment is part of the police's operational measures to ensure a peaceful, secure, and credible electoral process across the state. DIG Mohammed will coordinate the police component of election security and work with other agencies under the Inter-Agency Consultative Committee on Election Security (ICCES), supported by Assistant Inspectors-General of Police and Commissioners of Police deployed across Osun's three senatorial districts.

The IGP warned that ballot snatching, voter intimidation, political thuggery, and other electoral offences would attract immediate arrest and prosecution. He also reiterated a ban on armed escorts and unauthorised persons accompanying political figures to polling units or collation centres on election day, and barred state-established security outfits, including the Western Nigeria Security Network ("Amotekun"), and other quasi-security or private security groups from election-security duties.
The Force said security arrangements cover voters, INEC personnel, election materials, polling units, and collation centres, and urged eligible citizens to vote peacefully and without fear.

osun-election-ejigbo-violence-adc-candid.title: Osun Election: ADC Candidate Salaam Whisked Away as Violence Erupts at Polling Unit
osun-election-ejigbo-violence-adc-candid.excerpt: ADC governorship candidate Najeem Salaam was evacuated by security operatives after violence disrupted voting at his polling unit in Ejigbo, halting the election there.
paras: African Democratic Congress governorship candidate Najeem Salaam was whisked away by his security detail after violence erupted at his polling unit in Ejigbo, Osun State, on Saturday, disrupting voting in Saturday's governorship election.

The disturbance occurred at Unit 003, Iroyin Ayo Open Space, Ward 004, shortly after Salaam and his wife cast their votes, sending voters, INEC officials, observers, and journalists fleeing the area. Premium Times reported the unrest was triggered when a young voter seized campaign materials allegedly linked to vote-buying, sparking a confrontation with individuals connected to the materials. The ADC's publicity secretary, however, described the incident as an attempted attack on Salaam himself, saying he was saved by the timely intervention of nearby residents.

Personnel from the DSS and NSCDC later arrived to restore order but left after tensions remained high, and voting was suspended at the unit. Speaking afterward, Salaam said he believed he had been the target of a planned attack. "The plan was to even attack me, my personality," he told reporters, adding that his security team's quick action prevented the situation from escalating further.

osun-eu-observers-323-offences.html.title: Osun Election: EU Observers Report 323 Electoral Offences, 38 Security Incidents
osun-eu-observers-323-offences.html.excerpt: EU election observers recorded 323 electoral offences and 38 security incidents during Saturday's Osun governorship election, based on reports from 823 accredited observers.
paras: The EU Support to Democratic Governance in Nigeria Election Observation Hub recorded 323 cases of electoral offences and 38 security incidents during Saturday's Osun governorship election, based on reports from 823 accredited observers across the state's 30 local government areas.

Of the offences recorded across 726 monitored polling units, 103 involved alleged vote trading, 85 involved exposed ballots, and 38 involved campaigning at polling units. The Hub also documented 25 cases of thuggery, 12 attacks on electoral officials, and 9 cases of voter intimidation allegedly involving security personnel.

Despite the irregularities, the Hub described turnout as "impressive" and voting as largely peaceful overall, with 58 of 726 BVAS devices malfunctioning, though 41 were later repaired. It urged INEC and security agencies to address the identified gaps, and said it had verified 11 false claims circulating about the election.

osun-inec-declares-adeleke-winner.html.title: Osun Election: INEC Declares Adeleke Winner With 511,067 Votes
osun-inec-declares-adeleke-winner.html.excerpt: INEC has declared Governor Ademola Adeleke winner of the Osun governorship election with 511,067 votes, defeating APC's Bola Oyebamiji by a margin of 66,252 votes.
paras: The Independent National Electoral Commission has declared Governor Ademola Adeleke winner of the Osun State governorship election, securing him a second term after a closely fought race against APC's Bola Oyebamiji.

State Returning Officer Professor Joshua Ogunwole announced the result at the INEC collation centre in Osogbo early Sunday morning, following overnight collation of results from all 30 local government areas. Adeleke polled 511,067 votes to Oyebamiji's 444,815, a margin of 66,252 votes. ADC's Najeem Salaam finished a distant third with 17,180 votes. "Ademola Jackson Adeleke, having satisfied the requirements of the law, is hereby declared the winner and returned elected," Ogunwole said.

Adeleke, contesting on the Accord Party platform, won 19 of the state's 30 local government areas, including Ede North, Ede South, Ejigbo, Iwo, and Osogbo, while Oyebamiji carried the remaining 11. Turnout was strong: of 2,339,544 registered voters, 1,010,684 were accredited and 985,097 valid votes were cast. Supporters flooded the streets of Osogbo in celebration following the announcement, and former Vice President Atiku Abubakar and Labour Party's Peter Obi were among those to publicly congratulate Adeleke on his re-election.

osun-lawmaker-arrested-146-mercenaries.h.title: Osun Election: Accord Lawmaker Arrested With 146 Suspected Mercenaries in Ikire
osun-lawmaker-arrested-146-mercenaries.h.excerpt: Accord Party lawmaker Abiola Ibrahim Inaolaji was arrested in Ikire alongside 146 suspected mercenaries and over 200 PVCs during Saturday's Osun governorship election.
paras: The Osun State Police Command has arrested Abiola Ibrahim Inaolaji, an Accord Party lawmaker representing Irewole/Isokan State Constituency, alongside 146 suspected mercenaries found camped at his residence in Ikire during Saturday's governorship election.

Police spokesperson DSP Abiodun Ojelabi confirmed the arrest, carried out by operatives of the Federal Bureau of Investigation's Intelligence Response Team in the early hours of Saturday. "He was arrested in Ikire for harbouring suspected mercenaries. He was arrested with about 146 people," Ojelabi said. More than 200 Permanent Voter Cards were reportedly recovered at the scene.

In a video circulated online, Ibrahim identified himself and appeared to acknowledge facilitating the movement of the individuals into Osun State from neighbouring states ahead of the election, though he separately insisted to officers that the group were legitimate voters. "They are voters for the election happening today. Some of them are indigenes from outside. I did not hire them. I did not promise anything. Voting is their choice. I'm not their agent," Ibrahim said. The Special Assistant on Digital Media to Governor Adeleke separately alleged that security operatives laid siege to the residence of the Osun Assembly Speaker and detained an associate of the governor's, claims that have not been independently confirmed.

osun-oyebamiji-wins-boluwaduro-polling-u.title: Osun Election: Oyebamiji Defeats Adeleke at Boluwaduro Polling Unit
osun-oyebamiji-wins-boluwaduro-polling-u.excerpt: APC candidate Bola Oyebamiji defeated Governor Adeleke 68-39 at a polling unit in Boluwaduro Local Government Area, as split results emerge from across Osun State.
paras: APC governorship candidate Bola Oyebamiji defeated incumbent Governor Ademola Adeleke at a polling unit in Boluwaduro Local Government Area during Saturday's Osun State governorship election, according to a result sheet shared online after counting concluded.

Oyebamiji secured 68 votes against 39 recorded by Adeleke's Accord Party at Ward 6, Polling Unit 006, adding to a patchwork of unit-level results emerging from across the state as vote counting and sorting continued into the evening.

Voting across Osun's 3,763 polling units began around 9 a.m. and concluded by roughly 2:30 p.m. at most units, with Adeleke, Oyebamiji, and 13 other candidates contesting for the support of more than 2.3 million registered voters. As collation proceeds toward local government and state-level totals, both leading camps have posted wins in different pockets of the state, underscoring how closely fought the contest remains.

osun-pdp-chairman-arrested-ilesa.html.title: Osun Election: PDP Chairman Arrested in Ilesa, Adeleke Demands Release
osun-pdp-chairman-arrested-ilesa.html.excerpt: Governor Adeleke condemned the arrest of Osun's PDP Chairman, Sunday Bisi, calling it an attempt to intimidate his supporters during Saturday's governorship election.
paras: Osun State Governor Ademola Adeleke condemned the arrest of the state's PDP Chairman, Sunday Bisi, and called for his immediate release, alleging the move was intended to intimidate his supporters during Saturday's governorship election.

In a statement issued through his spokesperson, Olawale Rasheed, Adeleke said Bisi was arrested at his residence in Ilesa shortly after returning from voting, and taken to an undisclosed location without any reason given. "This latest sweep on my supporters... is part of a broader plan to give the APC unhindered access to change results at collation," the statement said.

The governor further accused the APC of working with what he described as compromised security agents to restrict independent monitoring of the collation process. The claims have not been independently verified by police.

oyedele-reforms-faac-2-trillion-monthly..title: Finance Minister Says Reforms Have Pushed Monthly FAAC Allocations Above ₦2 Trillion
oyedele-reforms-faac-2-trillion-monthly..excerpt: Finance Minister Taiwo Oyedele says Nigeria’s economic reforms have raised monthly federal allocations to states and local governments to over ₦2 trillion.
paras: Nigeria’s Minister of Finance and Coordinating Minister of the Economy, Taiwo Oyedele, has said the country’s economic reforms have increased monthly Federation Account Allocation Committee (FAAC) allocations to more than ₦2 trillion.
According to Oyedele, the reforms have significantly boosted the monthly federal allocation shared among the federal, state and local governments, strengthening subnational finances.

oyo-constable-resigns-depression-redeplo.title: Oyo CP Orders Probe as Police Constable Resigns Over Failed Redeployment
oyo-constable-resigns-depression-redeplo.excerpt: A police constable in Ibadan resigned citing depression and frustration after repeated requests for redeployment went unanswered. The Oyo Police Command has ordered an investigation.
paras: Oyo State Commissioner of Police, Abimbola Ayodeji Olugbenga, has ordered an investigation after a police constable, Daniel Aibana, resigned from the Nigeria Police Force citing depression and frustration over repeated failed attempts to secure a redeployment.

In a resignation letter addressed to the Inspector-General of Police and now circulating on social media, Aibana, attached to the EOD-CBRN Base 19 in Ibadan, said he had made "several attempts to seek demobilisation and redeployment to another department where I believed I could serve more effectively," but was not granted release. He said the decision to resign, effective August 10, was "a necessary step toward protecting my mental health and restoring stability to my life," rather than a reflection of ingratitude toward the force.

Reacting on X, the Oyo State Police Command described the matter as "purely an internal affair" and confirmed that the Commissioner of Police has ordered a thorough investigation into the circumstances surrounding the resignation.

oyo-police-arrest-10-human-parts-trade.h.title: Oyo Police Arrest 10 Over Alleged Human Parts Trade, Recover Heart, Skull
oyo-police-arrest-10-human-parts-trade.h.excerpt: The Oyo State Police Command has arrested 10 suspected members of a human parts dealing syndicate in Iseyin and Saki, recovering a suspected human heart, skull, and charms.
paras: The Oyo State Police Command has arrested 10 suspected members of a syndicate allegedly involved in the trade of human body parts, following months of intelligence gathering and discreet surveillance across the state.

The suspects, identified as Adam Ibrahim, Nasiru Kabiru, Tijani Wasiu, Abiola Nasiru, Amusa Gbadamosi, Raheem Taofeek, Jimoh Muritala, Suleiman Busari, Ganiyu Nurudeen, and Usman Abdullahi, were apprehended at separate hideouts in the Iseyin and Saki areas of the state by operatives of the Command Monitoring Unit. Police spokesperson DSP Olayinka Ayanlade said searches of the hideouts recovered "one suspected human heart, human flesh, pieces of human skull and assorted charms."

The recovered items have been secured for forensic examination as investigators work to determine their source and intended use. The suspects reportedly confessed to varying levels of involvement in the trade for ritual purposes and are assisting police with further investigations. Commissioner of Police Abimbola Ayodeji Olugbenga commended the operation and said efforts were ongoing to identify and arrest other members of the alleged syndicate.

paul-ibe-el-rufai-178-days-detention.htm.title: Atiku Aide Claims El-Rufai Detained 178 Days Over Political Persecution
paul-ibe-el-rufai-178-days-detention.htm.excerpt: Paul Ibe, an aide to former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, has renewed claims that ex-Kaduna Governor Nasir El-Rufai's prolonged detention amounts to political persecution for opposing President Tinubu.
paras: Paul Ibe, a media aide to former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, has again described the continued detention of former Kaduna State Governor Nasir El-Rufai as politically motivated, claiming he has now spent 178 days in custody for opposing President Bola Tinubu.

El-Rufai, a chieftain of the African Democratic Congress after defecting from the ruling APC, has been held by the Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission over an ongoing investigation into alleged financial impropriety during his time as governor. Ibe and other ADC-aligned figures have repeatedly called the detention a "sham legal trial," arguing El-Rufai has not yet been formally charged in court despite the length of his custody.

The claim adds to a running chorus of criticism from opposition figures, including 2027 presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore and El-Rufai's wife, who has separately appealed to Nigeria's international partners to press for due process in the case. The Presidency and ICPC have not directly responded to the political persecution characterisation, maintaining that the case concerns an active corruption investigation.

pdp-faction-osun-candidate-court-appeal..title: PDP Faction Claims Court Victory for Osun Candidate Who Already Endorsed Rival
pdp-faction-osun-candidate-court-appeal..excerpt: A PDP faction says the Court of Appeal upheld Adebayo Adedamola's Osun governorship nomination, but Adedamola himself endorsed rival candidate Adeleke just a day before the statement.
paras: A statement from the "Official PDP Nigeria" account says the Court of Appeal in Abuja has upheld the nomination of Adebayo Olugbenga Adedamola as the party's governorship candidate for Saturday's Osun election, and directed INEC to include the PDP's logo on the ballot. But the claim sits awkwardly alongside recent reporting: Adedamola himself publicly endorsed rival candidate Governor Ademola Adeleke of the Accord Party just a day before the statement was issued.

Adedamola, popularly known as "Fryo," won a PDP primary in December 2025 with 919 of 957 votes, but that primary was linked to a faction led by Kabiru Turaki and was not recognised by INEC in its final candidate list, amid Nigeria's long-running national leadership dispute within the PDP. On Wednesday, Adedamola told reporters in Osogbo that he was withdrawing his support from his own candidacy and backing Adeleke instead, citing "extensive consultations" and the political circumstances in the state.

The Turaki-aligned PDP statement, issued Thursday, insists the party's primary was properly monitored by INEC and that the commission wrongly refused to recognise the result. It's unclear how the party's court win, if accurately described, interacts with Adedamola's own public reversal just a day earlier. With the election now two days away, the ballot's final composition and any last-minute legal developments remain fluid.

peace-accord-2027-campaigns-begin.html.title: Political Leaders Sign Peace Accord as 2027 Campaign Season Begins
peace-accord-2027-campaigns-begin.html.excerpt: Leading presidential figures signed a peace accord as campaigning for the 2027 general election formally began.
paras: Leading political figures, including President Bola Tinubu, Peter Obi, Donald Duke, Omoyele Sowore and others, signed a peace accord as campaigning for the 2027 general election formally began, according to reports.
The accord signals a commitment to peaceful conduct ahead of what is expected to be a hard-fought contest between the ruling APC and opposition figures.

plateau-mangu-attack-over-20-killed.html.title: Over 20 Killed as Gunmen Raid Homes in Plateau’s Mangu LGA
plateau-mangu-attack-over-20-killed.html.excerpt: More than 20 people were reportedly killed in a midnight attack on Binper community in Mangu Local Government Area, Plateau State, as heavily armed men moved house to house.
paras: More than 20 people have reportedly been killed and several others injured after gunmen attacked Binper community in the Bwai District of Mangu Local Government Area, Plateau State. The attack occurred between midnight on Monday and the early hours of Tuesday, August 18, 2026.

According to residents, the heavily armed attackers moved from house to house, forcing their way into homes and targeting people who were asleep. An eyewitness, Daniel Musa, said more than 20 people had been confirmed dead as of Tuesday morning, with several others seriously injured and some still missing. Reports said several houses were burnt and farmlands destroyed.

The National President of the Mwaghavul Development Association, Bulus Dabit, confirmed the incident. Community members appealed to the newly appointed state Commissioner of Police to act decisively. The attack came less than a week after a separate incident in the same district left three people dead.
As of filing, security agencies had not issued an official statement confirming the casualty figure.

plateau-mining-pit-collapse-seven-killed.title: Seven Miners Killed as Mining Pit Collapses in Plateau Community
plateau-mining-pit-collapse-seven-killed.excerpt: Seven miners died after a mining pit collapsed on them at Kassa community in Barkin Ladi LGA, Plateau State, renewing calls for government regulation of mining sites.
paras: Seven miners have died after a mining pit collapsed on them at Kassa community in Barkin Ladi Local Government Area of Plateau State, in the latest of a series of similar tragedies to hit the state's mining communities.

Residents said the collapse occurred at around 7pm on Wednesday while the victims were carrying out mining activities at the site. A community member, Albert Danlami, said the victims were trapped underground, prompting residents and other miners to begin rescue efforts, though all seven were found dead by the time they were reached. Some other people were injured in the incident.

The Publicity Secretary of the Berom Youth Moulders Association, Rwang Tengwong, confirmed the deaths. Community members expressed grief and frustration over the recurring danger. "The pit was too deep and there were no safety measures. Government must come and regulate these mining sites before more lives are lost," said resident Timothy Bako. Mining pit collapses have claimed numerous lives in mining communities across Barkin Ladi, Jos South, Riyom, and other local government areas in Plateau State in recent years.

police-nationwide-operations-august-19.h.title: Police Report Arrests, Kidnap Rescues and Weapons Recoveries in 14 Operations Nationwide
police-nationwide-operations-august-19.h.excerpt: The Nigeria Police Force reported arrests, rescues and weapons recoveries across 14 operations nationwide in its August 19 operational summary.
paras: The Nigeria Police Force reported a series of successful operations across the country in its State-by-State Executive Summary for August 19, 2026, signed by Force spokesperson CSP Anietie Okokon Edem Iniedu.

In Abia State, operatives arrested a 55-year-old man allegedly attempting to vandalise rail tracks along the Aba–Owerri corridor, recovering a pump-action gun and tools. In Enugu State, separate operations led to the arrest of eight suspects and the recovery of two AK-47 rifles, a pistol, 63 rounds of ammunition and an explosive device, while three kidnapped victims were rescued along the Port Harcourt Expressway after officers engaged armed hoodlums who fled.
Suspects are undergoing investigation; none has been convicted of any offence.

premier-league-matchday-2-results-aug-20.title: Premier League: Man United Fall at Hull, Brentford Thrash Spurs in Matchday Two
premier-league-matchday-2-results-aug-20.excerpt: Manchester United slumped to a 2-0 defeat at Hull City and Brentford thrashed Tottenham 3-0 as the Premier League’s second matchday produced several surprises over the weekend.
paras: The Premier League’s second round of fixtures delivered early-season shocks over the weekend of August 21-23, 2026, headlined by Manchester United’s 2-0 defeat away to newly promoted Hull City on Saturday and Brentford’s emphatic 3-0 win over Tottenham Hotspur.

Defending champions Arsenal opened the round on Friday with a 3-0 victory over Coventry City. Saturday’s other results saw Leeds United edge Nottingham Forest 1-0, Everton beat Crystal Palace 2-0, and Ipswich Town come from behind to defeat Sunderland 2-1.

Sunday’s fixtures featured Manchester City hosting Bournemouth, Brighton & Hove Albion facing Aston Villa, and Newcastle United welcoming Liverpool, with Fulham v Chelsea to follow on Monday. The weekend’s results left several traditional heavyweights with early points to make up as the new campaign takes shape.

presidency-national-policing-bill-5pm-de.title: Presidency Sets 5pm Deadline for Public Input on National Policing Bill
presidency-national-policing-bill-5pm-de.excerpt: The Presidency has given Nigerians until 5pm today to submit views on the proposed National Policing Bill, focusing on safeguards against political interference and police misconduct.
paras: The Presidency has announced that public submissions on the proposed National Policing Bill, which would create a framework for state police, will close at 5pm on Thursday, August 13.

Chief of Staff to the President and Chairman of the Presidential Working Group on the Bill, Femi Gbajabiamila, said the consultation is designed to draw on the experiences and professional expertise of Nigerians. He urged contributions particularly on three questions: how police services can be shielded from political interference, who should investigate serious misconduct cases, and how federal and state forces can share intelligence across state boundaries. "For too long, the debate has been framed as a choice between effective local policing and protection from political abuse. Nigeria needs both," he said.

Gbajabiamila said the proposed framework must contain strong safeguards preventing governors from using state police against political opponents, protesters, journalists, or minority communities, and stressed that officers would remain subject to the Constitution and rule of law. He noted the consultation does not replace the National Assembly's role, which retains full power to scrutinise, amend, reject, or pass the Bill once transmitted. The Bill is scheduled to be presented to President Tinubu on September 3.

presidency-rejects-atiku-fuel-subsidy-20.title: Presidency, Wike Reject Atiku’s Pledge to Restore Petrol Subsidy if Elected in 2027
presidency-rejects-atiku-fuel-subsidy-20.excerpt: The Presidency and FCT Minister Nyesom Wike have rejected Atiku Abubakar’s pledge to restore petrol subsidy if elected president in 2027, describing the proposal as inconsistent and fiscally regressive.
paras: The Presidency and the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory, Nyesom Wike, have rejected former Vice President Atiku Abubakar’s pledge to restore petrol subsidy if elected president in 2027, describing the proposal as inconsistent, fiscally irresponsible and a reversal of Nigeria’s petroleum-sector reforms.

In a statement titled “Restoring Petrol Subsidies: Atiku’s Volte-Face and Desperation for Power,” the Special Adviser to the President on Information and Strategy, Bayo Onanuga, said Atiku — who backed subsidy removal ahead of the 2023 election — had “opportunistically recanted” his position five months before the 2027 vote. Onanuga rejected Atiku’s claim of a ₦30 trillion subsidy “windfall,” saying no such savings existed, and noted that the Petroleum Industry Act had already made the old subsidy regime illegal.

Wike, speaking during an inspection of infrastructure projects in Abuja, questioned Atiku’s consistency, recalling that the former vice president had previously condemned the subsidy. Atiku, now the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential candidate, had in an interview promised to reintroduce the subsidy, describing Tinubu’s removal policy as opaque and questioning where the savings had gone.

psg-sign-ferran-torres-barcelona.html.title: PSG Complete €50m Signing of World Cup Winner Ferran Torres From Barcelona
psg-sign-ferran-torres-barcelona.html.excerpt: Paris Saint-Germain have completed the signing of Spain forward Ferran Torres from Barcelona for around €50 million, reuniting him with coach Luis Enrique.
paras: Paris Saint-Germain have completed the signing of Barcelona forward Ferran Torres in a deal worth around €50 million, with the Spain international penning a five-year contract until 2031 and taking the number 9 shirt.

Torres, who scored the winning goal in extra time as Spain beat Argentina in the 2026 World Cup final, had entered the final year of his Barcelona contract and asked to leave despite the club's willingness to extend his deal. "I'm delighted to be beginning a new adventure at such an ambitious club as Paris Saint-Germain," Torres said, thanking club president Nasser Al-Khelaifi and coach Luis Enrique, who previously managed him with the Spanish national team.

Over four and a half seasons at Barcelona, Torres made 207 appearances and scored 65 goals, winning three La Liga titles, the Copa del Rey, and two Spanish Super Cups. The move reunites him with Luis Enrique at PSG, who are looking to build on their Champions League and UEFA Super Cup successes heading into the new season.

psg-uefa-super-cup-aston-villa.html.title: PSG Retain UEFA Super Cup With 2-1 Win Over Aston Villa
psg-uefa-super-cup-aston-villa.html.excerpt: Paris Saint-Germain won the UEFA Super Cup for a second consecutive year, beating Aston Villa 2-1 in Salzburg thanks to a late Désiré Doué winner.
paras: Paris Saint-Germain won the UEFA Super Cup for a second consecutive year, beating Aston Villa 2-1 in Salzburg on Wednesday to open their 2026-27 season with silverware.

Khvicha Kvaratskhelia put PSG ahead in the 20th minute, cutting inside from a Désiré Doué pass before firing past goalkeeper Marco Bizot. Aston Villa, competing in the final as Europa League champions, equalised before half-time through 17-year-old striker Brian Madjo, making his competitive debut for the club.

Doué struck what proved to be the winner in the 61st minute, running onto a through-ball from Ousmane Dembélé and finishing into the side-netting. The goal was initially flagged for offside before being awarded after a video review confirmed Villa defender Matty Cash had played him onside. Villa pushed for an equaliser in the closing stages but couldn't find a way past PSG's defence.

The win makes PSG only the fourth club in the competition's history to win the Super Cup in back-to-back years, following Ajax, AC Milan, and Real Madrid. It's PSG's fifth European trophy overall, coming just weeks after their second consecutive UEFA Champions League title. The club continues its season this weekend against Lens in the Trophée des Champions.

real-madrid-espanyol-la-liga-aug-2026.ht.title: Real Madrid Snatch Late 2-1 Win at Espanyol in La Liga
real-madrid-espanyol-la-liga-aug-2026.ht.excerpt: Substitute Carlos Espi struck in the 90th minute as Real Madrid came from behind to beat Espanyol 2-1 away in La Liga on Saturday.
paras: Real Madrid secured a dramatic 2-1 away victory over Espanyol in La Liga on Saturday, August 22, 2026, with substitute Carlos Espi firing home a late winner in the 90th minute.
The result saw Real Madrid recover to take all three points on the road in an early-season fixture, underlining their intent in the new Spanish top-flight campaign.
La Liga’s 2026-27 season is under way following Barcelona’s title triumph last term, with Real Madrid looking to reclaim the crown.

real-madrid-sign-denzel-dumfries.html.title: Real Madrid Confirm Denzel Dumfries Signing to Strengthen Defence
real-madrid-sign-denzel-dumfries.html.excerpt: Real Madrid have confirmed the signing of Netherlands international Denzel Dumfries on a contract running until 2030, pairing him with Trent Alexander-Arnold in defence.
paras: Real Madrid have confirmed the signing of Netherlands international Denzel Dumfries, with the full-back arriving to strengthen the right side of the club's defence alongside Trent Alexander-Arnold.
The Dutch international has signed a contract running until 2030, giving Los Blancos further depth and competition in the full-back positions heading into the new season.

The move is one of several high-profile signings across Europe's top leagues this summer, with clubs racing to complete their transfer business before the window closes on September 1. Real Madrid have been relatively measured in the market compared to some rivals, with the club publicly denying reports of interest in other high-profile targets such as Enzo Fernández earlier in the window.

Dumfries joins a Real Madrid squad preparing for another season competing on multiple fronts domestically and in Europe, with his versatility expected to give the club options both defensively and going forward down the right flank.

rivers-police-arrest-18-suspects-firearm.title: Rivers Police Arrest 18 Suspects, Recover 47 Firearms in Two-Month Crackdown
rivers-police-arrest-18-suspects-firearm.excerpt: The Rivers State Police Command has arrested 18 suspects, including a fake soldier, and recovered 47 firearms, 12 stolen vehicles, and 420 rounds of ammunition in operations since June.
paras: The Rivers State Police Command has arrested 18 suspected criminals, including a fake soldier allegedly involved in car snatching, and recovered 47 firearms of various calibres, 12 stolen vehicles, and 420 rounds of live ammunition in operations conducted across the state between June and August 12, 2026.

State Commissioner of Police, CP Olugbenga Adepoju, disclosed the figures while parading suspects and displaying recovered exhibits at the command's headquarters in Port Harcourt. Among the cases detailed was the June 29 killing of two police officers on stop-and-search duty in Aluu, in which hoodlums made away with two AK-47 rifles; police say three suspects linked to the attack have since been arrested, with the stolen rifles recovered.

Separately, operatives arrested two suspected members of a "one-chance" robbery syndicate and recovered firearms from a man accused of threatening his wife in Bonny. Adepoju said the command was working closely with the military, DSS, and other security agencies, and commended Inspector-General of Police Olatunji Disu for his support, urging residents to keep sharing credible information with police.

ronaldo-marries-georgina-portugal.html.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Marries Georgina Rodríguez in Private Portugal Ceremony
ronaldo-marries-georgina-portugal.html.excerpt: The Portuguese superstar and his longtime partner tied the knot in Cascais after a decade together, in an intimate ceremony attended by their five children.
paras: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez are officially husband and wife. The couple married on Tuesday in a civil ceremony in Cascais, a coastal town in western Portugal near Lisbon, according to the footballer’s PR team, which described it as “a private and intimate moment attended by their five children.”

Ronaldo, 41, announced the news himself, sharing a photo of the couple’s hands showing their wedding bands, captioned simply “C ❤️ G.” The wedding capped a decade-long relationship that began when the pair met in Madrid in 2016.

The ceremony followed days of speculation in Portuguese media over its timing and location, with earlier reports pointing to Madeira, Ronaldo’s birthplace. Instead, the couple pulled off the celebration far more privately.

The five-time Ballon d’Or winner, who recently played in his record-tying sixth World Cup for Portugal, currently plays for Saudi club Al-Nassr. Rodríguez rose to prominence in her own right through the Netflix series “I Am Georgina.”

rudeboy-okoye-family-feud-statement.html.title: Rudeboy Breaks Silence on Okoye Family Feud, Calls for Privacy
rudeboy-okoye-family-feud-statement.html.excerpt: Paul Okoye, known as Rudeboy, has asked for privacy as the public feud between his brothers Peter and Jude Okoye continues to escalate online.
paras: Paul Okoye, known professionally as Rudeboy, has spoken out for the first time on the escalating public feud within his family, asking for privacy as the dispute with his twin brother Peter Okoye — known as Mr P — continues to play out online.

In a statement released through his management, Fire Department Inc., Rudeboy acknowledged the intense public interest in the matter but insisted that family issues are best resolved with "dignity, respect, and responsibility." The statement added that he would not be drawn into "an exchange of allegations or commentary" that distracts from his music and his fans.

The rift traces back to a long-running dispute between the Okoye brothers — Peter, Paul, and their older brother and former manager Jude — over the P-Square legacy, including accusations of financial misconduct and disputes over ownership of the group's back catalogue. Tension escalated further in recent weeks after Peter made comments about his children not speaking Igbo, which Paul appeared to respond to online, and after Peter released a series of videos detailing personal allegations involving their late mother and his wife, Lola.

Rudeboy's management urged fans and media to rely on verified information rather than speculation, while pointing to the continued success of his recent single "Blessed & Alive," featuring Sarkodie, as proof his focus remains on music.

The latest escalation followed the eighth episode of a video series in which Peter alleged that family members — including their late mother, Josephine Okoye — confronted him and his wife, Lola, shortly after the birth of their son. He described a family meeting at his Lagos residence attended by brothers Jude, Paul, and Tony, along with pastors, at which he says neither he nor Lola were properly welcomed. Paul's camp has not directly addressed that specific claim.

The dispute has also touched on business matters, with Peter separately accusing Jude of financial misconduct and withholding access to the group's back catalogue — allegations Jude has not publicly detailed a response to. Rudeboy's management says he intends to stay out of that side of the dispute entirely.

saibari-bayern-munich-signing.html.title: Bayern Munich Confirm Ismael Saibari Signing
saibari-bayern-munich-signing.html.excerpt: Bayern Munich have confirmed the signing of Moroccan international Ismael Saibari on a deal worth around €55 million.
paras: Bayern Munich have officially confirmed the signing of Moroccan international Ismael Saibari, with the midfielder joining the Bundesliga champions on a contract running until 2031.
The deal is understood to be worth in the region of €55 million, reflecting Saibari's rising profile after a string of standout performances that drew interest from several of Europe's leading clubs.
Saibari joins a Bayern squad already stacked with attacking and midfield talent, adding further depth as the club prepares to defend its domestic and continental ambitions this season.

sangare-brentford-record-transfer.html.title: Brentford Break Club Transfer Record for Sangare
sangare-brentford-record-transfer.html.excerpt: Brentford have signed Malian midfielder Sangare from Lens for £41 million, a new club-record transfer fee.
paras: Brentford have completed a club-record signing, agreeing a deal worth £41 million to sign midfielder Sangare from French side Lens.

The Malian international, regarded as one of the most talented young midfielders to emerge from Ligue 1 in recent seasons, had attracted interest from several clubs across Europe before opting to join the Premier League side.
Sangare travelled to England to complete his medical and finalise the contract, with the transfer confirmed as one of the standout deals of the day across Europe's major leagues.

sao-paulo-bus-seized-bolivia-marijuana.h.title: São Paulo's Bus Seized in Bolivia With 86kg of Marijuana Ahead of Copa Sudamericana Clash
sao-paulo-bus-seized-bolivia-marijuana.h.excerpt: A bus hired to transport São Paulo FC's delegation in Bolivia was seized by police after officers found 86 kilograms of marijuana hidden inside. The club's squad never boarded the vehicle.
paras: A bus bearing São Paulo FC's branding was seized by Bolivian police after officers discovered more than 86 kilograms of marijuana hidden inside, in a bizarre incident that unfolded just before the Brazilian club's Copa Sudamericana round-of-16 first leg against Bolívar.

Police stopped the vehicle overnight between Tuesday and Wednesday at Villa Tunari in Bolivia's Cochabamba department, a region known for coca cultivation. Inside, they found 65 rectangular packages containing a green substance concealed in shopping bags. Subsequent testing confirmed it was marijuana, with the total weight recorded at 86.55 kilograms.

Crucially, São Paulo's squad never boarded the bus in question. The vehicle, operated by transport company Buses Cosmos, had originally been assigned to carry the delegation during their stay in Santa Cruz de la Sierra, but the club was given a different coach before the seizure took place. Buses Cosmos said responsibility for the incident rested with the Bolivian drivers, not the club.

Three people connected to the vehicle were arrested and taken in for questioning, with a custody hearing expected to determine whether they remain in detention. Bolivia's National Police and Public Prosecutor's Office have opened an investigation into the drugs' origin and intended destination. According to Brazilian outlet UOL, which first reported the story, São Paulo's delegation was unaware of the incident at the time and continued to their hotel without disruption using the replacement bus.

sec-crypto-30m-fee-2bn-capital-rules.htm.title: SEC Proposes ₦30m Registration Fee, ₦2bn Capital Requirement for Crypto Firms
sec-crypto-30m-fee-2bn-capital-rules.htm.excerpt: Nigeria’s Securities and Exchange Commission has proposed a ₦30m registration fee and a minimum capital requirement of up to ₦2bn for digital asset exchanges and custodians under new draft rules.
paras: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has proposed a ₦30 million registration fee and a minimum capital requirement of up to ₦2 billion for digital asset exchanges and custodians operating in Nigeria, under draft rules on “Digital and Virtual Asset Operations, Custody and Markets” released on August 20, 2026.

Under the framework, digital asset exchanges (DAXs) and digital asset custodians (DACs) would each require ₦2 billion in minimum capital, while digital asset platform operators, offering platforms and real-world asset tokenisation platforms would require ₦500 million each. Virtual asset service providers would need ₦200 million. Beyond the ₦30 million registration fee, applicants would pay a ₦100,000 processing fee and a ₦300,000 application fee, with additional charges for firms entering the SEC’s Accelerated Regulatory Incubation Programme.

The rules also require that regulated entities be incorporated in Nigeria, maintain a registered office in the country, keep their CEO or managing director resident in Nigeria, and hold a fidelity insurance bond covering at least 25 per cent of their minimum paid-up capital. The move builds on the SEC’s January 2026 decision to raise exchange capital requirements and President Tinubu’s Virtual Assets Coordination Executive Order, which created a CBN-led Virtual Asset Council.

sec-freezes-assets-terrorist-financiers..title: SEC Freezes Assets of Six Individuals, Three Firms Over Terrorism Financing
sec-freezes-assets-terrorist-financiers..excerpt: Nigeria's SEC has ordered capital market operators to freeze assets of six individuals and three Bureau de Change firms designated as terrorist financiers linked to ISWAP.
paras: The Securities and Exchange Commission has directed capital market operators to immediately freeze the funds, assets, and economic resources of six individuals and three entities designated as terrorist financiers by the Nigeria Sanctions Committee.

The directive, issued in a circular to all Capital Market Regulated Entities, follows the designation of the individuals and entities under the Terrorism Prevention and Prohibition Act 2022. The six named individuals are Babangida Muhammed Adamu Hammajam, Abdullahi Umar Usman, Ibrahim Abubakar, Adamu Chiroma, Muktar Muhammad Adamu, and Yakubu Ogirima Ibrahim, while the three designated firms are Nine to Nine BDC Ltd, Generation Currency BDC Ltd, and Abbal Bako & Sons Bureau de Change.

According to the SEC, the individuals and entities were designated over alleged involvement in financing the Islamic State West Africa Province, including through Bureau de Change operations allegedly used to move funds linked to the group's Okene and Kogi cells. Operators have been ordered to freeze the listed assets without prior notice, report all compliance actions to the Sanctions Committee, and file suspicious transaction reports with the Nigerian Financial Intelligence Unit. Non-compliance, the SEC warned, could attract fines, suspension, or revocation of registration.

shallipopi-seyi-vibez-tiblaze-label-disp.title: Shallipopi, Seyi Vibez and T.I Blaze Drag Label Boss Over Unpaid Royalties
shallipopi-seyi-vibez-tiblaze-label-disp.excerpt: Three prominent Nigerian artists have publicly accused their label boss of unpaid royalties and alleged signature forgery.
paras: Nigerian music stars Shallipopi, Seyi Vibez and T.I Blaze have publicly called out their record label boss over alleged unpaid royalties and signature forgery, in a dispute that has drawn wide attention across the Nigerian music scene.

The artists aired their grievances publicly, adding to a growing pattern of Nigerian acts speaking out about contractual and financial disputes with their labels. The allegations have not been independently verified, and the label has not publicly responded.

sokoto-1.7bn-motorcycles-banditry.html.title: Sokoto Approves N1.7bn for 1,000 Motorcycles to Fight Banditry
sokoto-1.7bn-motorcycles-banditry.html.excerpt: The Sokoto State Government has approved N1.759 billion for 1,000 Bajaj motorcycles to boost security agencies' mobility in the fight against banditry.
paras: The Sokoto State Government has approved N1.759 billion for the purchase of 1,000 Bajaj motorcycles to support security agencies in tackling banditry and strengthen security operations across the state.

The approval came at the sixth regular meeting of the Sokoto State Executive Council for 2026, presided over by Deputy Governor Idris Muhammad Gobir. According to Director-General of Media and Publicity Abubakar Bawa, the motorcycles will complement 62 armoured vehicles worth N27 billion the state recently acquired and distributed to security agencies.

The government said the additional motorcycles would improve the mobility of security personnel, particularly in remote communities and difficult terrain affected by banditry. The council also approved N90.21 million for plumbing infrastructure serving 142 semi-urban water supply schemes across the state.

sokoto-boat-capsize-50-dead-goronyo.html.title: At Least 50 Dead, Mostly Children, as Overloaded Boat Capsizes in Sokoto
sokoto-boat-capsize-50-dead-goronyo.html.excerpt: An overloaded boat carrying farm workers and children capsized on a river near Gorau in Sokoto State’s Goronyo LGA, killing at least 50 people in one of the year’s deadliest waterway disasters.
paras: At least 50 people, most of them children, have died after an overloaded boat capsized on Thursday, August 20, 2026, near Gorau in the Goronyo Local Government Area of Sokoto State, according to officials, witnesses and residents.

The boat was carrying more than 70 people — mostly farm owners and hired labourers heading to rice farms, along with children aged between 10 and 15 — when it capsized shortly after setting off to cross the river, residents said. Abdulkadir Yusuf, Sokoto state manager at the National Inland Waterways Authority, put the toll at 47 “so far,” while eyewitnesses at the scene said the number of recovered bodies had risen past 50, with some reports citing 53. Officials said 16 people had been rescued, and the village head was among the survivors.

A Reuters witness saw dozens of bodies, many wrapped in mats and traditional cloths, laid out at a community mosque in Gorau ahead of burial. Rescue operations were continuing on Thursday, with local divers searching for the missing.

Deadly boat accidents are relatively common in Nigeria, where overcrowding, poor maintenance and weak enforcement of safety rules contribute to disasters on the country’s rivers, especially during the rainy season.

super-falcons-eliminated-world-cup-south.title: Super Falcons Eliminated From World Cup Race After 2-1 Loss to South Africa
super-falcons-eliminated-world-cup-south.excerpt: Nigeria's Super Falcons have been eliminated from 2027 World Cup contention after losing 2-1 to South Africa in a qualifying playoff, ending their run of qualifying for every edition since 1991.
paras: Nigeria's Super Falcons have been eliminated from contention for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup after losing 2-1 to South Africa in a qualifying playoff at the Larbi Zaouli Stadium in Casablanca on Thursday.

South Africa's Thembi Kgatlana put Banyana Banyana ahead in the 56th minute, with Refiloe Jane doubling the lead in the 77th. Nigeria pulled a goal back through Chiamaka Ucheibe deep into stoppage time, but it wasn't enough to force extra time.

The result ends Nigeria's unbroken run of qualifying for every edition of the Women's World Cup since the tournament began in 1991. Both teams had already missed out on automatic qualification after quarter-final exits at the 2026 WAFCON — Nigeria to Cameroon, South Africa to hosts Morocco — with Thursday's match serving as a playoff for one of Africa's two remaining routes into the intercontinental qualifying tournament. South Africa now advances to the next stage, while Nigeria's route to Brazil 2027 has closed entirely.

super-falcons-wafcon-eliminated-cameroon.title: Super Falcons Knocked Out of WAFCON 2026, Miss Automatic World Cup Ticket
super-falcons-wafcon-eliminated-cameroon.excerpt: Nigeria's ten-time African champions lost 1-0 to Cameroon in the WAFCON quarter-final, missing out on automatic qualification for the 2027 World Cup.
paras: Nigeria's Super Falcons have been eliminated from the 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations after a 1-0 defeat to Cameroon in the quarter-final at the Larbi Zaouli Stadium in Casablanca, ending the defending champions' title defence earlier than expected.

The result also cost Nigeria automatic qualification for the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup in Brazil, a prize that had been on the line for both sides going into the tie. Nigeria will instead have to negotiate the African playoff route to keep their World Cup hopes alive, extending an unbroken run of appearances at every edition of the tournament since it began in 1991.

It marks the first time the ten-time African champions have failed to reach at least the semi-finals of a centralised WAFCON tournament, and comes after a shaky group stage in which Nigeria lost their opening match to debutants Malawi before recovering with a win over Zambia and a 6-2 thrashing of Egypt to scrape through in second place.

Cameroon, by contrast, arrived unbeaten, having topped their group with wins over Mali and Ghana before a draw with Cape Verde. The Indomitable Lionesses had lost nine of their previous eleven meetings with Nigeria, including a 1-0 defeat to the Super Falcons in the quarter-finals of the 2022 edition, but this time held firm behind a goalkeeper who produced a string of crucial saves to deny Nigeria an equaliser, including a header from Uchenna Kanu in the second half.

Cameroon's win sets up a semi-final against tournament hosts Morocco, and confirms their own place at the 2027 World Cup. For Nigeria, attention now turns to a play-off against South Africa for one of the continent's remaining World Cup qualification spots.

tinubu-icpc-fake-agency-arrest-perm-secs.title: Tinubu Orders Arrest of Fake-Agency Promoter, Suspends Three Permanent Secretaries in ICPC Probe
tinubu-icpc-fake-agency-arrest-perm-secs.excerpt: President Tinubu has ordered the arrest of George Buchi Nwabueze and suspended three permanent secretaries after the ICPC uncovered another fake government agency operating inside the Office of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation.
paras: President Bola Tinubu has ordered the immediate arrest of one George Buchi Nwabueze and the suspension of three permanent secretaries after the Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission (ICPC) uncovered another fake government agency operating within the Office of the Secretary to the Government of the Federation (OSGF).

ICPC Chairman Dr Musa Aliyu, SAN, disclosed the directives on Friday, August 21, 2026, while briefing State House correspondents in Abuja. He said the fake office — operating under the name “National Brands Development and Made-in-Nigeria Special Project Office” — had been allocated space within the OSGF without presidential authorisation and contrary to law. The suspended permanent secretaries were named as M.S. Danjuma, Nadungu Gagare and Richard P. Pheelangwah.

The discovery is the latest fallout from the ICPC’s investigation into the fictitious Presidential Foreign Intervention Promotion Council (PFIPC), whose self-styled Director-General, Adeniyi Adeyemi Matthew, is already facing forgery and impersonation charges. Investigators said Nwabueze had operated under at least four other name variations. The case brings the number of fake agencies uncovered in the PFIPC scandal to four since April. No wrongdoing has been established against those under investigation.

tinubu-orders-niger-mosque-abduction-res.title: Tinubu Orders Coordinated Rescue After Niger Mosque Mass Abduction
tinubu-orders-niger-mosque-abduction-res.excerpt: President Tinubu has ordered the military, police and DSS to launch an immediate coordinated operation to rescue victims of a mass abduction at a mosque in Niger State, calling the attackers “enemies of peace and humanity.”
paras: President Bola Tinubu has directed the Armed Forces, the Nigeria Police Force, the Department of State Services (DSS) and other security and intelligence agencies to immediately launch a coordinated operation to rescue victims of the recent mass abduction in Niger State.

In a statement issued on Tuesday, August 25, 2026, by his Special Adviser on Information and Strategy, Bayo Onanuga, the President said he was outraged by the abduction and killing of innocent citizens, describing the perpetrators as “enemies of peace and enemies of humanity, who will not go scot-free.” He ordered the Service Chiefs to provide regular briefings on the rescue until every victim is accounted for.

The abduction occurred on Friday, August 21, 2026, when armed men attacked the Kpenya Mosque in the Dekara area of Borgu Local Government Area and surrounding communities, including Gidan-Zana and Sabon Gida, seizing worshippers during Friday gatherings. Residents said a large number of women, children and elderly people were taken. “Terror will not cow Nigeria. We will defend our people, protect our communities, and uphold the sanctity of human life,” Tinubu said, pledging federal support for relief, recovery and security reinforcement.

tinubu-renews-nan-md-nta-dg-tenure.html.title: Tinubu Renews Tenure of NAN MD and NTA DG for Another Three Years
tinubu-renews-nan-md-nta-dg-tenure.html.excerpt: President Tinubu has renewed the tenure of NAN Managing Director Ali Mohammed Ali and NTA Director-General Abdulhamid Dembos for another three-year term, effective October 2026.
paras: President Bola Tinubu has renewed the tenure of the Managing Director of the News Agency of Nigeria (NAN), Malam Ali Mohammed Ali, and the Director-General of the Nigerian Television Authority (NTA), Abdulhamid Salihu Dembos, for another three-year term.

In a statement issued on Sunday, the Special Adviser to the President on Information and Strategy, Bayo Onanuga, said the two media chiefs were first appointed on October 20, 2023, and that their second term will begin on October 20, 2026.

Onanuga described Ali as a veteran journalist and media manager with over 30 years of experience and a keen interest in digital media evolution, while Dembos, from Yola in Adamawa State, is a former National President of the Radio, Television, Theatre and Art Workers Union (RATTAWU) who rose through the NTA’s ranks. President Tinubu urged both executives to justify the confidence reposed in them and to continue promoting the government’s Renewed Hope Agenda.

tinubu-shettima-cibn-banking-conference-.title: Tinubu, Shettima to Headline CIBN Banking Conference in September
tinubu-shettima-cibn-banking-conference-.excerpt: President Tinubu, VP Shettima, and CBN Governor Cardoso will headline the Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria's 19th Annual Banking and Finance Conference in Abuja.
paras: President Bola Tinubu, Vice President Kashim Shettima, and Central Bank of Nigeria Governor Olayemi Cardoso are among the dignitaries expected to headline the Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria's 19th Annual Banking and Finance Conference, scheduled for September 8-9 at the Transcorp Hilton in Abuja.

Described as the largest gathering of banking and financial professionals in Africa, the conference is expected to draw over 10,000 delegates including banking executives, regulators, fintech leaders, and development partners, with World Bank Country Director for Nigeria Matthew Verghese delivering the keynote address. CIBN President Dele Alabi said the event would focus on economic resilience amid technological and geopolitical disruption, adding, "an economy cannot grow to a $1 trillion mark without the support of the financial services sector."

The conference will feature sessions examining the implications of bank recapitalisation, artificial intelligence, and geopolitical dynamics on Nigeria's financial system, with CIBN urging banks to deploy fresh capital raised from recapitalisation toward supporting MSMEs as the country pursues its economic growth targets.

tinubu-signs-npera-bill-ports-regulator..title: Tinubu Signs NPERA Bill Into Law, Creating Dedicated Port Regulator
tinubu-signs-npera-bill-ports-regulator..excerpt: President Tinubu has assented to the Nigerian Ports Economic Regulatory Agency Bill, establishing a dedicated economic regulator for the port sector after more than a decade of delays.
paras: President Bola Tinubu has assented to the Nigerian Ports Economic Regulatory Agency (NPERA) Bill 2026, establishing a dedicated statutory economic regulator for Nigeria's port sector after more than a decade of stalled attempts to pass the legislation.

Nigerian Shippers' Council Executive Secretary Dr. Pius Akutah disclosed the assent in a social media post, thanking the President "for making it a reality." The new agency replaces an arrangement dating to 2014, under which the Shippers' Council performed economic regulatory functions at the ports without a dedicated law backing its authority. The new legislation gives the regulator power over tariffs, rates, charges, competition, licensing of port service providers, and resolution of commercial disputes.

The bill's path to signature was rocky — Tinubu had previously withheld assent over concerns about possible duplication of functions with the Nigerian Ports Authority and NIMASA, sending it back to the National Assembly for revision. An amended version passed in April 2026 before finally clearing the way for presidential assent this week. Marine and Blue Economy Minister Adegboyega Oyetola called it a "landmark development" that would strengthen regulation and improve efficiency across the country's ports.

tinubu-swears-in-enitan-head-civil-servi.title: Tinubu Swears In Abel Enitan as New Head of Civil Service of the Federation
tinubu-swears-in-enitan-head-civil-servi.excerpt: President Tinubu has sworn in Abel Olumuyiwa Enitan as the new Head of Civil Service of the Federation, succeeding Didi Esther Walson-Jack, who retired at the mandatory age of 60.
paras: President Bola Tinubu on Thursday, August 27, 2026, swore in Mr Abel Olumuyiwa Enitan as the new Head of Civil Service of the Federation (HoCSF), at a brief ceremony held at the State House, Abuja.

Enitan succeeds Mrs Didi Esther Walson-Jack, who retired after attaining the mandatory retirement age of 60. Tinubu had named Enitan, the most senior Permanent Secretary in the Federal Civil Service, as the incoming Head of Service on August 19, 2026, with the appointment taking formal effect on August 27. Walson-Jack presented her handover note, covering her tenure from August 14, 2024, to August 27, 2026, before the two officials exchanged a handshake to mark the transfer of responsibilities.

Enitan, an indigene of Osun State, had served as Permanent Secretary for seven years and seven months across the Ministry of Police Affairs, the Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs, the Office of the Vice President, the Ministry of Environment and, most recently, the Federal Ministry of Education. President Tinubu urged him to uphold the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, accountability and efficiency, and to build a more merit-driven and responsive civil service in line with the administration’s Renewed Hope Agenda.

tinubu-urges-nlng-end-gas-flaring.html.title: Tinubu Urges NLNG to Maximise Gas Reserves, End Flaring for Domestic Benefit
tinubu-urges-nlng-end-gas-flaring.html.excerpt: President Tinubu has urged the Nigeria Liquefied Natural Gas (NLNG) board to eliminate gas flaring and convert the resource into greater economic benefit for Nigerians, prioritising domestic gas utilisation.
paras: President Bola Tinubu has urged the management of Nigeria Liquefied Natural Gas (NLNG) to do all within its powers to ensure Nigeria derives maximum benefit from its gas reserves rather than allowing them to be flared.

The President made the remarks on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, at the State House, Abuja, while receiving members of the NLNG Board led by Managing Director and CEO, Engineer Adeleye Falade. Tinubu said the company’s focus should extend beyond increasing revenue from international markets to ensuring greater domestic utilisation of Nigeria’s gas resources, converting flaring from an environmental liability into an economic asset for consumers.

Falade told the President that NLNG’s capacity had increased to five of its six available trains following improved crude oil production, and that all of the company’s liquefied petroleum gas (cooking gas) output is currently supplied to the domestic market. He added that the company is keen to inaugurate a seventh production train, which would boost capacity by 35 per cent, and disclosed that the NLNG-financed Bonny-Bodo Road and Bridge project has been completed and awaits commissioning.

trabzonspor-darwin-nunez-al-hilal-loan.h.title: Trabzonspor Closing In on Darwin Núñez Loan From Al-Hilal
trabzonspor-darwin-nunez-al-hilal-loan.h.excerpt: Turkish side Trabzonspor are in advanced talks to sign Darwin Núñez on loan from Al-Hilal, with the prospect of reuniting the striker with former Liverpool teammate Mohamed Salah.
paras: Turkish side Trabzonspor are in advanced talks to sign Uruguayan striker Darwin Núñez on loan from Saudi club Al-Hilal, with the move edging closer to completion.

Trabzonspor have proposed an €8 million loan payment for Núñez, whose value has fallen sharply since joining Al-Hilal from Liverpool for €53 million last year. Talks are being led directly by club chairman Ertuğrul Doğan and his deputy İbrahim Şahinkaya, with Núñez reportedly having already agreed personal terms.

A key factor in the move is the prospect of reuniting with former Liverpool teammate Mohamed Salah, who joined Trabzonspor earlier this summer. The two played together at Anfield between 2022 and 2025. Should the transfer go through, Núñez would fly to Turkey to complete a medical and sign his contract, with both clubs still working through the final financial details.

turkey-pkk-pardon-bill.html.title: Turkey's Parliament Approves Conditional Pardon for PKK Militants
turkey-pkk-pardon-bill.html.excerpt: Turkey's parliament has approved legislation offering a conditional pardon to thousands of Kurdish militants, contingent on the PKK's full disarmament.
paras: Turkey's parliament has approved legislation introducing a conditional pardon for thousands of Kurdish militants, in a bid to advance the government's peace initiative with the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK). Lawmakers voted 468-88 in favour of the measure.

The pardon will only take effect once Turkish authorities have verified that the PKK has fully disarmed. The group announced last year that it was ending its decades-long armed campaign against the Turkish state, following a call from its imprisoned leader, Abdullah Ocalan, and has since staged a symbolic disarmament ceremony in northern Iraq.

The 12-article bill outlines procedures for the group's disarmament and the rehabilitation of thousands of PKK members, suspending some prison sentences and postponing ongoing investigations for five to ten years depending on the severity of alleged offences. Militants convicted of intentional killings, including Ocalan and other senior figures sentenced before 2005, are excluded from the pardon.

Pro-Kurdish DEM party lawmaker Gulistan Kilic Kocyigit told parliament the vote gave "the people of Turkey, who have paid a heavy price for many years... an opportunity to consolidate peace and build democracy," while critics said the bill failed to address broader demands for democratic reform and Kurdish rights.

uk-travel-advisory-11-nigerian-states.ht.title: UK Warns Citizens Against All Travel to 11 Nigerian States Over Insecurity
uk-travel-advisory-11-nigerian-states.ht.excerpt: The UK’s FCDO has updated its Nigeria travel advisory, warning against all travel to parts of 11 states and all-but-essential travel to 19 more states and the FCT, citing terrorism, kidnapping and intercommunal violence.
paras: The United Kingdom has updated its travel advisory for Nigeria, warning British nationals against all travel to parts of 11 states and against all but essential travel to parts of 19 states and the Federal Capital Territory, citing rising insecurity, terrorism, kidnapping and intercommunal violence.

The advisory, published by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) on Thursday, August 20, 2026, placed Borno, Yobe, Adamawa and Gombe in the North-East, and Katsina and Zamfara in the North-West, under its highest “advise against all travel” category. The same designation covers the riverine areas of Delta, Bayelsa, Rivers, Akwa Ibom and Cross River states — described as river and swamp locations accessible by boat but not by road.

Under the “all but essential travel” category, the FCDO listed Bauchi, Kaduna, Kano, Kebbi, Jigawa and Sokoto in the north; Niger, Kogi, Plateau, Taraba, Kwara and Benue in the North-Central; and Abia, Anambra and Imo in the South-East, along with the FCT. The FCDO also urged caution in Lagos, particularly on the mainland, and warned that travel insurance could be invalidated if citizens travel against its advice.

umahi-orders-arrest-benin-asaba-contract.title: Umahi Orders Arrest of Contractors Removing Asphalt on Benin-Asaba Highway
umahi-orders-arrest-benin-asaba-contract.excerpt: Works Minister David Umahi has ordered the arrest of any contractor found removing asphalt from existing carriageways, criticising the slow pace and poor handling of the Benin-Asaba Highway project.
paras: Minister of Works, Engineer David Umahi, has ordered the arrest of any contractor found removing asphalt from existing carriageways without authorisation, after criticising the concessionaire handling the Benin-Asaba Highway over its slow pace of work and alleged failure to follow engineering standards.

Umahi issued the directive on Tuesday, August 25, 2026, during an on-the-spot assessment of the 125-kilometre highway, which runs from the AIF Roundabout in Benin City, Edo State, to Summit Junction in Asaba, Delta State. He faulted the Benin-Asaba Expressway Concession Company Limited (BAECC) for what he described as unprofessional conduct, noting that removing asphalt without constructing adequate side drains had damaged the road’s sub-structure and worsened conditions for motorists and host communities despite repeated warnings from the Ministry and the project’s Independent Engineer.

The minister apologised to commuters and residents of Edo and Delta states for the hardship caused by the ongoing reconstruction and directed all Federal Controllers of Works to arrest any contractor or concessionaire found removing asphalt from existing federal roads without approval. A follow-up meeting involving the Federal Government, the concessionaire and the Edo State Government was scheduled for Wednesday, August 26, at the Edo State Government House.

unicef-child-safe-journalism-nigeria.htm.title: UNICEF Urges Nigerian Journalists to Put Children’s Safety and Dignity First
unicef-child-safe-journalism-nigeria.htm.excerpt: UNICEF has called on Nigerian journalists to make the safety, dignity, privacy and best interests of children central to how they report stories.
paras: The United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF) has urged Nigerian journalists to make the safety, dignity, privacy and best interests of children central to their reportage.
The appeal emphasises ethical, child-sensitive journalism — particularly in coverage involving minors in conflict, abuse or vulnerable situations.

us-appoints-new-consul-general-lagos.htm.title: US Appoints Brandon Hudspeth as New Consul General in Lagos
us-appoints-new-consul-general-lagos.htm.excerpt: The US Mission in Nigeria has welcomed Brandon Hudspeth as the new Consul General at its Lagos consulate, returning to a post where he previously served.
paras: The United States Mission in Nigeria has announced Brandon Hudspeth as the new Consul General at the US Consulate General in Lagos. Hudspeth returns to Nigeria, where he previously served as the consulate’s Political-Economic Section Chief.

Most recently, he served as Deputy Chief of Mission in Namibia. According to the mission, he brings global experience from postings in the Philippines, Mali, Cuba and Afghanistan, as well as service in Washington at the Operations Center and the Bureau of African Affairs.
