The mission said it looks forward to strengthening US–Nigeria ties under his leadership.

us-mission-welcomes-dcm-jimmy-mauldin.ht.title: US Mission Welcomes New Deputy Chief of Mission Jimmy Mauldin to Abuja
us-mission-welcomes-dcm-jimmy-mauldin.ht.excerpt: The US Mission in Nigeria has announced the arrival of its new Deputy Chief of Mission, Jimmy Mauldin, in Abuja.
paras: The United States Mission in Nigeria has announced the arrival of its new Deputy Chief of Mission (DCM), Jimmy Mauldin, in Abuja. In a message to Nigerians, the mission said Mauldin “wants to know Nigeria better” and invited the public to share suggestions on the country’s food, culture and the issues he should prioritise.
The announcement is part of the mission’s public engagement as it introduces its new leadership team, following its recent welcome of a new Consul General in Lagos.

wizkid-burna-asake-tems-bet-2026-nominat.title: Wizkid, Burna Boy, Asake and Tems Land 2026 BET Awards Nominations
wizkid-burna-asake-tems-bet-2026-nominat.excerpt: Four Nigerian stars — Wizkid, Burna Boy, Asake and Tems — have received nominations at the 2026 BET Awards.
paras: Nigerian Afrobeats stars Wizkid, Burna Boy, Asake and Tems have been nominated at the 2026 BET Awards, according to Vanguard, marking another strong showing for Nigerian music on a major international stage.
The nominations reinforce the continued global rise of Afrobeats and the prominence of Nigerian artists in international award conversations.

wizkid-detty-december-fest-2026.html.title: Wizkid to Headline Detty December Fest 2026 Opening Night
wizkid-detty-december-fest-2026.html.excerpt: Wizkid will headline the opening night of Detty December Fest 2026 on December 18 in Lagos, kicking off 13 days of music, culture, and fashion.
paras: Grammy-winning Afrobeats star Wizkid will headline the opening night of Detty December Fest 2026, organizers Livespot360 announced, kicking off 13 days of music, culture, food, and fashion in Lagos.

The opening concert is scheduled for Friday, December 18, at the Detty December Village, with the festival running through December 30. This year's edition introduces a second stage — Wizkid will headline the main Festival Stage, while a new Pulse Stage will spotlight emerging artists.

Last year's inaugural Detty December Fest drew more than 40,000 festivalgoers with a lineup including Busta Rhymes, Gunna, Shenseea, and Tiwa Savage — with Wizkid himself making a surprise appearance during Gunna's headline set. General Access tickets for this year's opening night are priced at ₦50,000, with VIP options up to ₦300,000. Additional headliners are expected to be announced in the coming weeks.

yalda-moaiery-iran-photojournalist-sente.title: Iranian Photojournalist Yalda Moaiery Sentenced to 15 Years Over Reporting
yalda-moaiery-iran-photojournalist-sente.excerpt: Acclaimed Iranian photojournalist Yalda Moaiery has been sentenced in absentia to 15 years in prison over images and interviews shared with foreign media outlets.
paras: Iranian photojournalist Yalda Moaiery has been sentenced in absentia to 15 years in prison by Branch 29 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court, on charges of activities in the interests of foreign states, over reporting and photographs she shared with international media.

Moaiery, who has spent roughly two decades documenting conflict, protest, and the lives of women in Iran, learned of the sentence on Iran's National Journalist Day. The charges reportedly relate to interviews she gave to media outlets and photographs she shared with organisations that Iranian authorities deemed hostile, including images of damage from airstrikes during the 2025 conflict between Israel and Iran.

The court also ordered the confiscation of her cameras and electronic devices, barred her from cultural and media activities and public office, and banned her from posting on social media. Moaiery has previously been imprisoned for her work, including two years served over her coverage of Iran's 2022 "Woman, Life, Freedom" protests. The International Federation of Journalists condemned the sentence as baseless and called for her release, along with that of all journalists detained in the country.

zambia-election-vote-count-suspended-vio.title: Zambia: Vote Count Suspended Over Violence and Ballot Theft, Then Resumed
zambia-election-vote-count-suspended-vio.excerpt: Vote counting in Zambia's presidential election was temporarily suspended after reports of violence and ballot theft at some polling stations, before resuming with results expected Monday.
paras: Vote counting in Zambia's presidential election was temporarily suspended following reports of violence and ballot theft at a number of polling stations, before electoral officials resumed the process, with final results now expected Monday.

The Electoral Commission of Zambia confirmed disruptions at several counting centres, including incidents in which ballot materials were allegedly seized or destroyed by unidentified individuals. Security forces were deployed to affected areas to restore order and secure remaining ballot boxes as counting resumed.

The election has drawn close attention from regional observers given Zambia's recent history of contested transitions. Both leading candidates have urged supporters to remain calm and await the official outcome through legal channels, as international and domestic observer missions continue monitoring the collation process.

zamfara-gunmen-kill-10-vigilantes.html.title: Gunmen Reportedly Kill 10 Vigilantes in Fresh Zamfara Attack
zamfara-gunmen-kill-10-vigilantes.html.excerpt: At least 10 vigilantes were reportedly killed in a fresh attack by gunmen in Zamfara State, deepening security fears in the community.
paras: At least 10 vigilantes were reportedly killed in a fresh attack by gunmen in Zamfara State, according to reports, spreading fear across the affected community.

The attack adds to persistent insecurity in Nigeria’s North-West, where community security volunteers have increasingly been targeted. Details were still emerging and official confirmation of the toll was awaited.

zamfara-troops-rescue-18-lakurawa-arrest.title: Troops Rescue 18 Kidnap Victims, Arrest Two Lakurawa Suspects in Zamfara
zamfara-troops-rescue-18-lakurawa-arrest.excerpt: Troops of Operation Fansan Yamma rescued 18 abducted persons and arrested two suspected Lakurawa terrorists in separate operations across Zamfara State.
paras: Troops of Sector 2, Operation Fansan Yamma, rescued 18 kidnapped persons and arrested two suspected members of the Lakurawa terrorist group in separate counter-terrorism operations across Zamfara State on Monday.

In the first operation, troops responded to a distress call reporting terrorists sighted on the outskirts of Sabon Gari village in Kaura Namoda Local Government Area. On arrival, they engaged the terrorists and rescued 18 abducted persons, including a local resident, Alhaji Aminu Dayau, and his children. Some of the terrorists escaped across a river with other captives before troops could reach them. The military says efforts to locate and rescue the remaining victims are ongoing.

In a separate, intelligence driven operation, troops arrested two suspected Lakurawa members, identified as Abdul Rahman Bouye and Mohammed Jamilu, both nationals of Niger Republic, over alleged involvement in planting improvised explosive devices along the Zurmi-MSR road. Both suspects remain in military custody pending handover to the Department of State Services for further investigation.

The operations form part of a wider counter-terrorism push across Nigeria's North-West, where Lakurawa, a relatively new armed group blamed for a string of attacks in Sokoto, Kebbi, and Zamfara states, has increasingly been targeted alongside long-established banditry networks.
